description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A unique token used to ensure idempotence. Generated by the client. The value must be unique across requests and cannot exceed 64 ASCII characters in length.
